A frightened woman calls the police after spotting a man armed with a fully automatic Glock! What looks like an ordinary handgun may be hiding a dangerous modification: a Glock switch, a tiny device that converts a semi-automatic pistol into a machine gun. These illegal modifications have become a growing concern for American law enforcement.
